title: Apple Pie Crescents
description: This apple pie with crescent roll crust recipe is made with a Granny Smith apple, brown sugar, and apple pie spice — all the fall flavors with no fuss.
ingredients: 1 small Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, cut into 8 (1/2-inch) slices
1 (8 ounce) can Pillsbury® refrigerated crescent dinner rolls

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper.
Toss apple slices with 1 ½ tablespoons melted butter in a bowl until evenly coated; set aside.
Separate crescent roll dough into 8 triangles. Combine brown sugar and apple pie spice in a small bowl; sprinkle evenly over triangles. Top each triangle with 1 apple slice.
Wrap dough around apple slices, starting at long sides of each triangle; place on the prepared cookie sheet. Brush rolled triangles with remaining 1 ½ tablespoons melted butter.
Bake in the preheated oven until deep golden brown and apples are softened, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool before serving for 5 minutes.
